answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using proof of space-time, where nodes store verifiable cryptographic plots on dedicated media. Verifiers stream a river of random read challenges that nodes must answer within intervals timed by quartz oscillators. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of purchasing and powering physical storage per identity, rendering free mass registration a fable.
